# Bhavya Dhoot

> Quantitative developer and AI systems engineer based in Dubai, UAE. Builds and
> operates production AI, automation, and quantitative trading systems. Works as
> a hands-on AI automation consultant from a founder's office, alongside
> quantitative research in Indian equity derivatives. CS undergraduate at
> Vellore Institute of Technology, class of 2027. Open to quant and AI roles.

Site: https://bhavya-dhoot.vercel.app/
Contact: dhoot.bhavya1@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/bhavya-dhoot/
Last updated: 2026-07-28

## What he does

- **AI automation consulting** — scopes, builds, deploys, and operates production
  AI systems end to end: LLM document-extraction pipelines, deterministic
  citation-backed insight engines, voice agents (n8n, RetellAI), and unattended
  reporting and distribution layers.
- **Quantitative development** — options pricing engines, systematic momentum
  research, backtesting infrastructure, and real-time market signal pipelines.
- **Applied ML research** — RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, reinforcement
  learning, and agent-based simulation of market dynamics.

  trading infrastructure for Indian equity derivatives.

  securities and 8 sectors.

## Selected work

- **NSE Momentum** — Survivorship-free cross-sectional momentum on NSE small and
  mid-caps. Out-of-sample Sharpe near 1.44, +23% CAGR, maximum drawdown -6.6%,
  Fama-MacBeth Newey-West t of about 2.7. Python research engine cross-validated
  against an independently written Rust engine. Methodology available on request.
- **Kronos NSE** — Fine-tuned a 24.7M-parameter foundation model on a 305K-window
  NSE dataset, feeding a five-layer Market Variance Engine. Under 340ms from
  candle close to signal. 139 passing tests.
  https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot/Kronos-nse
- **Options Pricer & Paper Trading Terminal** — Black-Scholes engine with full
  Greeks, warm-start Newton-Raphson implied-volatility solver (80–90% computation
  reduction), SPAN-like margin engine, 29 multi-leg strategy templates.
  https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot/Options_Pricer_Jm
- **The Health Factory AI Operations Suite** — 7+ production systems replacing
  manual sales reporting, production planning, and supply-chain reconciliation
  with unattended daily pipelines. Architecture under NDA.
- **LLM Flash Crash** — Agent-based simulation (500 agents, 160 Monte Carlo runs)
  of systemic risk from homogeneous LLM traders; +30.3% drawdown amplification at
  full adoption. https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot/LLM-flash-crash
- **ARAS** — Multi-agent research pipeline; 88% retrieval accuracy over a 50K+
  document corpus, 70% reduction in research cycle time.
  https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot/Autonomous-Research-Agent-System-ARAS-
- **DRL Quantum Sensing & Routing** — GNN-PPO routing achieving near-Heisenberg
  scaling and +51% quantum Fisher information over the strongest baseline.
  https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot/drl-quantum-sensing-routing
- **Quantum Cyclone Classification** — IQP-kernel QSVM on IBTrACS storm data,
  96.1% accuracy. https://github.com/Bhavya-Dhoot/quantum-cyclone-classification

## Technical stack

Languages: Python, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, SQL.
Data: Pandas, NumPy, Polars, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite.
Quant: options pricing (BSM), Greeks, SPAN margin, cross-sectional momentum,
factor research, backtesting, Monte Carlo, GARCH, HMM regimes, time series.
AI/ML: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, RAG pipelines, FAISS, ChromaDB, multi-agent
systems, n8n, PyTorch, LightGBM, reinforcement learning (PPO), Qiskit.
Infrastructure: FastAPI, Node.js, Next.js, React, Docker, GitHub Actions,
systemd, GCP Cloud Run, Oracle Cloud, Render, Playwright, Airflow, MLflow, Odoo.
